Subject: Your breach of contract matter - CS(COMM) 2734/2021

Dear Ms. Natarajan,

Thank you for meeting us on 9 June 2022 about your dispute with Saffron Industries. As we understand it, the goods supplied were defective. The matter is listed before the Warangal Commercial Court.

Our advice is to claim liquidated damages as fixed in the contract. Please collect the inspection reports and the rejection notices and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Zubin Contractor
